# GitHub Copilot — workspace entry

Shared workspace instructions live in the root `AGENTS.md`, which Copilot reads 
natively. This file carries Copilot-only notes; keep it short, because Copilot CLI 
combines all applicable instruction files with no defined precedence — conflicts 
cost tokens and consistency.

- Run `/instructions` in the CLI to see which instruction files this session loaded.
- Copilot-specific techniques: `docs/tips-copilot.md`.
